segments.mn42:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn42:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena verañjakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
segments.mn42:2.3: “samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn42:2.4: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.mn42:2.5: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
segments.mn42:2.6: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
segments.mn42:2.7: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ; kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti’.
segments.mn42:2.8: Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
segments.mn42:3.1: Atha kho verañjakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā appekacce bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu; appekacce bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu; appekacce yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu; appekacce bhagavato santike nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu; appekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho verañjakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.mn42:4.1: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti?
segments.mn42:4.2: Ko pana, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī”ti?
segments.mn42:5.1: “Adhammacariyāvisamacariyāhetu kho, gahapatayo, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
segments.mn42:5.2: Dhammacariyāsamacariyāhetu kho, gahapatayo, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī”ti.
segments.mn42:6.1: “Na kho mayaṃ imassa bhoto gotamassa saṃkhittena bhāsitassa, vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa, vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāma.
segments.mn42:6.2: Sādhu no bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā mayaṃ imassa bhoto gotamassa saṃkhittena bhāsitassa, vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa, vitthārena atthaṃ ājāneyyāmā”ti.
segments.mn42:6.3: “Tena hi, gahapatayo, suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.mn42:6.4: “Evaṃ bho”ti kho verañjakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.mn42:7.1: “Tividhaṃ kho, gahapatayo, kāyena adhammacārī visamacārī hoti, catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacārī visamacārī hoti, tividhaṃ manasā adhammacārī visamacārī hoti.
segments.mn42:8.1: “Kathañca, gahapatayo, tividhaṃ kāyena adhammacārī visamacārī hoti?
segments.mn42:8.2: Idha, gahapatayo, ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti. Luddo lohitapāṇi hatappahate niviṭṭho adayāpanno pāṇabhūtesu.
segments.mn42:8.3: Adinnādāyī kho pana hoti. Yaṃ taṃ parassa paravittūpakaraṇaṃ … taṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātā hoti.
segments.mn42:8.4: Kāmesumicchācārī kho pana hoti. Yā tā māturakkhitā … tathārūpāsu cārittaṃ āpajjitā hoti.
segments.mn42:8.5: Evaṃ kho, gahapatayo, tividhaṃ kāyena adhammacārī visamacārī hoti.
segments.mn42:9.1: “Kathañca, gahapatayo, catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacārī visamacārī hoti?
segments.mn42:9.2: Idha, gahapatayo, ekacco musāvādī hoti. Sabhāgato vā … sampajānamusā bhāsitā hoti.
segments.mn42:9.3: Pisuṇavāco kho pana hoti. Ito sutvā amutra akkhātā … vaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
segments.mn42:9.4: Pharusavāco kho pana hoti. Yā sā vācā aṇḍakā kakkasā … tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
segments.mn42:9.5: Samphappalāpī kho pana hoti. Akālavādī … apariyantavatiṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.
segments.mn42:9.6: Evaṃ kho, gahapatayo, catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacārī visamacārī hoti.
segments.mn42:10.1: “Kathañca, gahapatayo, tividhaṃ manasā adhammacārī visamacārī hoti?
segments.mn42:10.2: Idha, gahapatayo, ekacco abhijjhālu hoti … pe … taṃ mamassā’ti.
segments.mn42:10.3: Byāpannacitto kho pana hoti paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo – ime sattā haññantu vā … mā vā ahesun’ti.
segments.mn42:10.6: Evaṃ kho, gahapatayo, tividhaṃ manasā adhammacārī visamacārī hoti.
segments.mn42:10.7: “Evaṃ adhammacariyāvisamacariyāhetu kho, gahapatayo, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
segments.mn42:11.1: “Tividhaṃ kho, gahapatayo, kāyena dhammacārī samacārī hoti, catubbidhaṃ vācāya dhammacārī samacārī hoti, tividhaṃ manasā dhammacārī samacārī hoti.
segments.mn42:12.1: “Kathañca, gahapatayo, tividhaṃ kāyena dhammacārī samacārī hoti?
segments.mn42:12.2: Idha, gahapatayo, ekacco pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
segments.mn42:12.3: Adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, yaṃ taṃ parassa … taṃ nādinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātā hoti.
segments.mn42:12.4: Kāmesumicchācāraṃ pahāya … tathārūpāsu na cārittaṃ āpajjitā hoti.
segments.mn42:12.5: Evaṃ kho, gahapatayo, tividhaṃ kāyena dhammacārī samacārī hoti.
segments.mn42:13.1: “Kathañca, gahapatayo, catubbidhaṃ vācāya dhammacārī samacārī hoti?
segments.mn42:13.2: Idha, gahapatayo, ekacco musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti. Sabhāgato vā … pe … na sampajānamusā bhāsitā hoti.
segments.mn42:13.3: Pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya … samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
segments.mn42:13.4: Pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya … tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
segments.mn42:13.5: Samphappalāpaṃ pahāya … kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
segments.mn42:13.6: Evaṃ kho, gahapatayo, catubbidhaṃ vācāya dhammacārī samacārī hoti.
segments.mn42:14.1: “Kathañca, gahapatayo, tividhaṃ manasā dhammacārī samacārī hoti?
segments.mn42:14.2: Idha, gahapatayo, ekacco anabhijjhālu hoti. Yaṃ taṃ parassa paravittūpakaraṇaṃ taṃ nābhijjhātā hoti ‘aho vata yaṃ parassa, taṃ mamassā’ti.
segments.mn42:14.3: Abyāpannacitto kho pana hoti appaduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo – ‘ime sattā averā abyābajjhā anīghā sukhī attānaṃ pariharantū’ti.
segments.mn42:14.5: ‘atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ … sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
segments.mn42:14.6: Evaṃ kho, gahapatayo, tividhaṃ manasā dhammacārī samacārī hoti.
segments.mn42:14.7: “Evaṃ dhammacariyāsamacariyāhetu kho, gahapatayo, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
segments.mn42:15.2: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti;
segments.mn42:15.3: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.
segments.mn42:16-17.2: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ gahapatimahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti;
segments.mn42:16-17.4: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā gahapatimahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.
segments.mn42:18-42.2: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā cātumahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti;
segments.mn42:18-42.3: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā cātumahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.
segments.mn42:18-42.7: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ … yāmānaṃ devānaṃ … tusitānaṃ devānaṃ … nimmānaratīnaṃ devānaṃ … paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ … brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti;
segments.mn42:18-42.13: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.
segments.mn42:18-42.17: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā ābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti;
segments.mn42:18-42.18: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā ābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.
segments.mn42:18-42.21: “Ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parittābhānaṃ devānaṃ … pe … appamāṇābhānaṃ devānaṃ … ābhassarānaṃ devānaṃ … parittasubhānaṃ devānaṃ … appamāṇasubhānaṃ devānaṃ … subhakiṇhānaṃ devānaṃ … vehapphalānaṃ devānaṃ … avihānaṃ devānaṃ … atappānaṃ devānaṃ … sudassānaṃ devānaṃ … sudassīnaṃ devānaṃ … akaniṭṭhānaṃ devānaṃ … ākāsānañcāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ … viññāṇañcāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ … ākiñcaññāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ … nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti;
segments.mn42:18-42.38: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.
segments.mn42:43.2: ‘aho vatāhaṃ āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyan’ti;
segments.mn42:43.3: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati,‘yaṃ so āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya.
segments.mn42:44.1: Evaṃ vutte, verañjakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.mn42:44.3: Seyyathāpi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti; evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
segments.mn42:44.4: Ete mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.mn42:44.5: Upāsake no bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gate”ti.

lines: Kevalañhi idha adhammacārī visamacārīti evaṃ puggalādhiṭṭhānā desanā katā.

Tissannaṃ tāva jhānabhūmīnaṃ vasena nava brahmalokā, pañca suddhāvāsā catūhi ārūpehi saddhiṃ navāti aṭṭhārasa, vehapphalehi saddhiṃ ekūnavīsati, te asaññaṃ pakkhipitvā vīsati brahmalokā honti, evaṃ chahi kāmāvacarehi saddhiṃ chabbīsati devalokā nāma.
Tesaṃ sabbesampi bhagavatā dasakusalakammapathehi nibbatti dassitā.
Tattha chasu tāva kāmāvacaresu tiṇṇaṃ sucaritānaṃ vipākeneva nibbatti hoti.
Uparidevalokānaṃ pana ime kammapathā upanissayavasena kathitā.
Dasa kusalakammapathā hi sīlaṃ, sīlavato ca kasiṇaparikammaṃ ijjhatīti.
Sīle patiṭṭhāya kasiṇaparikammaṃ katvā paṭhamajjhānaṃ nibbattetvā paṭhamajjhānabhūmiyaṃ nibbattati;
rūpāvacarajjhānaṃ pādakaṃ katvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā anāgāmiphale patiṭṭhito pañcasu suddhāvāsesu nibbattati;
rūpāvacarajjhānaṃ pādakaṃ katvā arūpāvacarasamāpattiṃ nibbattetvā catūsu arūpesu nibbattati;
rūpārūpajjhānaṃ pādakaṃ katvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti.
Asaññabhavo pana bāhirakānaṃ tāpasaparibbājakānaṃ āciṇṇoti idha na niddiṭṭho.
Keci pana “vividharaṭṭhavāsino verañjakā”ti etamatthaṃ vadanti, tesaṃ matena “verajjakā”ti pāḷiyā bhavitabbanti.
Ayaṃ visesoti ayaṃ puggalādhiṭṭhānadhammādhiṭṭhānakato imesu dvīsu suttesu desanāya viseso, attho pana desanānayo ca majjhe bhinnasuvaṇṇaṃ viya avisiṭṭhoti dasseti.
Kasmā pana bhagavā katthaci puggalādhiṭṭhānadesanaṃ deseti, katthaci dhammādhiṭṭhānanti?
Desanāvilāsappattā hi buddhā bhagavanto, te yathāruci katthaci puggalādhiṭṭhānaṃ katvā, katthaci dhammādhiṭṭhānaṃ katvā dhammaṃ desenti.
Ye pana veneyyā sāsanakkamaṃ anotiṇṇā, tesaṃ puggalādhiṭṭhānadesanaṃ desenti.
Saddhācaritatāya vā lokādhipatīnaṃ vasena puggalādhiṭṭhānā, paññācaritatāya dhammādhipatīnaṃ vasena dhammādhiṭṭhānā.
Iti bhagavā taṃ taṃ visesaṃ avekkhitvā tattha tattha duvidhaṃ desanaṃ desetīti veditabbaṃ.
Vīsati brahmalokāti taṃtaṃbhavapariyāpannanikāyavasena vīsati brahmalokā, vīsati brahmanikāyāti attho.
Dasakusalakammapathehīti yathārahaṃ dasakusalakammapathehi kammūpanissayapaccayabhūtehi kevalaṃ upanissayabhūtehi ca nibbatti dassitā.
Vipākenevāti iminā vipākuppādeneva nibbatti hoti, na upanissayatāmattenāti dasseti.

“paṭhamena jhānena nīvaraṇānaṃ pahānaṃ sīlaṃ, veramaṇi sīlaṃ, cetanā sīlaṃ, saṃvaro sīlaṃ, avītikkamo sīlan”tiādinā sabbesupi jhānesu sīlaṃ uddhaṭanti tassa vasena uparidevalokānampi vipākena nibbatti vattabbāti?
Na, tassa pariññāya desanattā, pariññāya desanatā cassa “yattha ca pahānan”tiādinā visuddhimaggasaṃvaṇṇanāya ñca (visuddhi. mahāṭī.2.837,839) pakāsitā eva.
Tathā hi idhāpi “dasa kusalakammapathā hi sīlan”tiādinā sīlassa rūpārūpabhavānaṃ upanissayatā vibhāvitā, na nibbattakatāya.
Kasmā panettha bhāvanālakkhaṇāya dhammacariyāya bhavavisese vibhajiyamāne asaññabhavo na gahitoti āha “asaññabhavo pana … pe … na niddiṭṭho”ti.
Bāhirakā hi ayathābhūtadassitāya asaññabhavaṃ bhavavippamokkhaṃ maññamānā tadupagajjhānaṃ bhāvetvā asaññesu nibbattanti.
Ayamettha saṅkhepo, yaṃ panettha vattabbaṃ, taṃ brahmajālaṭṭhakathāyaṃ taṃsaṃvaṇṇanāya ñca (dī. ni. aṭṭha.1.68-73; dī. ni. ṭī.1.68-73) vuttanayeneva veditabbaṃ.
